issues.issue: Was the police conduct an abuse of statutory stop and search powers under the Saskatchewan Highways and Transportation Act?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants argue police exceeded regulatory search powers when suspicion of criminal activity arose and searched duffle bag unlawfully.
issues.respondent_position: Police acted within statutory authority; search was lawful and reasonable under H&TA and Charter.
issues.result_text: Search was authorized, reasonable, and did not invade reasonable privacy interests.

issues.issue: Should evidence of drug dealing and proceeds of crime be excluded under sections 8 or 9 of the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms?
issues.applicant_position: Trial judge excluded evidence due to Charter breaches; argued warrantless searches and arrest invalid.
issues.respondent_position: Court of Appeal and Crown argued evidence admissible; searches and arrest lawful and reasonable under Charter.
issues.result_text: Evidence admissible; warrantless searches and arrest lawful; appeal dismissed.

issues.issue: Were the warrantless searches during random roadside stops reasonable under section 8 of the Charter?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants contend warrantless searches exceeded lawful authority and violated privacy rights.
issues.respondent_position: Crown asserts searches authorized by law, reasonable, and conducted in reasonable manner.
issues.result_text: Warrantless search authorized by law, reasonable, and met Charter standards.

issues.issue: Did the random vehicle stops violate section 9 of the Charter against arbitrary detention?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants argue stops were arbitrary and violated s. 9 rights.
issues.respondent_position: Crown argues stops justified under s. 1 for highway-related purposes and not arbitrary.
issues.result_text: Random stops related to legitimate highway purposes; no s. 9 violation.

issues.issue: Was the officer's arrest of the appellants based on reasonable and probable grounds?
issues.applicant_position: Trial judge found arrest invalid due to insufficient grounds.
issues.respondent_position: Crown argues cumulative facts provided reasonable and probable grounds for arrest.
issues.result_text: Cumulative facts objectively supported reasonable and probable grounds for arrest.

issues.issue: Was the search of the vehicle and seizure of marijuana incident to the lawful arrest reasonable and lawful?
issues.applicant_position: Trial judge found no exigent circumstances justified warrantless search after arrest.
issues.respondent_position: Crown argues search incidental to arrest was lawful and reasonable without exigent circumstances.
issues.result_text: Search incidental to valid arrest was lawful and reasonable; seizure compliant with Charter.

issues.issue: Was the inventory search conducted by Corporal Houston lawful and was the evidence admissible?
issues.applicant_position: Inventory search was invalid warrantless search breaching s. 8; evidence should be excluded.
issues.respondent_position: Evidence from inventory search should be admitted under s. 24(2) due to minimal impact and trial interest.
issues.result_text: Inventory search breach was technical; evidence admitted balancing all factors under s. 24(2).
